note: Benzenesulphonyl chloride plus a secondary amine giving N,N-diethylbenzenesulphonamide and HCl. Drawn as benzene ring - S with two double-bonded O - Cl, plus H-N(-C2H5)(-C2H5) with one C2H5 to the right and the second drawn below the nitrogen, a plain arrow with nothing written over or under it, then the same sulphonyl group bonded to N(-C2H5)(-C2H5), plus HCl. The arrow carries no reagent, so the agents field is left empty. Both C2H5 labels are condensed and read as ethyl. The amine's single N-H is written out in the drawing and is implicit in the SMILES; the product nitrogen is drawn with three bonds and no H, as written. The ring is drawn Kekule (alternating inner lines, no circle). The product caption printed beneath is 'N,N-Diethylbenzenesulphonamide'. No stereochemistry is drawn.
